projectDescription: A browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge that enhances YouTube Music with beautiful time-synced lyrics, real-time translations, romanization, karaoke mode, a CSS theme marketplace, and a community lyrics platform called Unison.
keyFeatures: Time-synced lyrics with syllable, word, and line-level highlighting
Real-time translations and romanization for foreign-language tracks
Karaoke subtitles mode overlaying lyrics on music video fullscreen
CSS theme marketplace with community-created and custom themes
Unison community lyrics platform for submitting and voting on corrections
16 configurable lyrics providers with drag-to-reorder priority
Fullscreen mode with playback controls and seekable progress bar
Blurred album art background and stylized animations
publicApiSurface: CSS custom properties: --blyrics-* variables for theme customization
Extension settings: General, Display, Language, Sources, Themes, Identity tabs
Lyrics providers: Better Lyrics, Unison, BiniLyrics, Musixmatch, LRCLib, YouTube, YouTube Captions
Extension permissions: storage, alarms, optional downloads
Build scripts: npm run dev, npm run build, npm run build:zip, npm run build:release
Dock control order: source, translate, romanize, offset, refresh, pictureInPicture
